title: Ask ChatGPT What It Knows About You
description:
What happens when you ask ChatGPT to find your personal information online?

You may discover more than you expected. AI can help you understand your digital footprint and decide what to do next.

Learn more practical AI uses in our free weekly live classes. Access them through the link in our profile.
